Warehouse Associate – Night Shift
Northgate Supply Co. (fictional)

About the role
You will pick, pack and ship customer orders in our 80,000 sq ft distribution centre. It's a busy, physical job where accuracy matters and every shift ends with the trucks leaving on time.

Your day
• Pick orders using a handheld scanner and pack them carefully
• Load and unload trucks, by hand and with a pallet jack
• Operate a forklift once certified (we train you)
• Keep aisles clear and follow all safety rules
• Count stock and report damaged items

About you
• Able to lift up to 23 kg and be on your feet for a 10-hour shift
• Available Sunday to Thursday nights, 8 pm to 6 am
• Comfortable using a scanner and basic computer
• Forklift certification is an asset
• Steel-toe boots required

About Northgate Supply Co.
Northgate Supply Co. is a fictional family-owned distributor founded in 1987. We deliver hardware and building supplies across the region and we are proud of our safety record.

Shift premium for nights, benefits after 3 months, free parking.
